$comment: SEAM MANIFEST — which user-facing seams have a test that ENTERS the seam, not just the inner unit. A seam is COVERED only when the spec (a) exists, (b) contains seamEvent — the gesture/call proving it enters, and (c) contains negativeSpec — the no-op/refusal assertion. Statuses: COVERED (all three verified) · COVERED_NO_NEGATIVE (enters the seam, negative case MISSING — an honest admission) · OPEN (no seam-entering spec). The gate fails only on a FALSE claim, never on an honest admission. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-15-seam-coverage/SEAM-COVERAGE.md

NEGATIVEs are the product rules: a deliberate late entry (outside the bounded search window) is never auto-touched, a low-confidence rise is never acted on, and a shift list that does not line up with the loop passes is ignored rather than guessed at. The measurement is best-effort by construction — a buffer without channel data must never take the placement down with it.

seams.note: A Pro Tools user can search 'Bounce Mix' to reach KYX's Export panel action with the active shortcut beside it; the same vocabulary stays out of results when another DAW profile is selected.

seams.seamEvent: fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: "U", ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true })
seams.negativeSpec: rejects colliding chords
seams.note: Users can remap central actions with safe modified chords; collisions with another global action are rejected and the original binding remains active until a valid chord is captured.

seams.seamEvent: fireEvent.keyDown(document.body, { key: "U", ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true })
seams.negativeSpec: does not open Arrangement before the chord is assigned
seams.note: The custom chord does nothing before assignment, then opens the actual Arrangement panel through the live app keyboard handler once registered.

seams.negativeSpec: does not let an unselected audio clip hijack Tab track navigation
seams.note: An audio clip elsewhere in the project must not consume Tab; transient navigation only applies when an audio clip is selected.
